subject: N0TED

decision.verdict: DO_NOT BUILD N0TED AS A SECOND BRAIN
reason: N0TE already owns Artist/Song intelligence, durable product memory, context, planning/reasoning, capability resolution and user-facing autonomy.
The construction controller already owns repository reconstruction, bounded work selection, build orchestration, verification and reconciliation.
A third autonomous semantic/planning/memory layer would duplicate one or both and increase authority/context drift.

prohibited_n0ted_responsibilities: independent durable memory or context database
repository construction governance already owned by the controller

roles_that_could_justify_the_name_if_lat.constraints: No semantic authority. Runs bounded background IPC/process/device services for N0TE, exposes health and lifecycle, stores no parallel product truth.
Restarts or observes bounded N0TE runtime services; cannot infer artist intent, select product actions, mutate Song state, or become construction controller.
Routes authenticated local IPC among N0TE Core, ARK, DAW bridges/plugin host; protocol/transport only, not reasoning.

naming_rule: Do not reserve a component merely because the N0TED name exists in conversation. Create it only if an implementation need emerges that is operational, narrow, testable, and cannot coherently live in N0TE Core, ARK/Bridge/plugin host, app runtime, or the external construction controller.
current_action: No N0TED product code should be added. Preserve the name only as an unallocated implementation label, not as accepted architecture.
revisit_trigger: A concrete runtime requirement appears with a boundary contract showing unique inputs/outputs, lifecycle, failure isolation, authority exclusions, and why existing components cannot own it.
